coverage.landlord_size_condition: No size threshold stated; applies to all landlords and foreclosing owners.
coverage.summary: Covers residential tenancies and post-foreclosure occupancies of units in the City of Boston, with no landlord-size or unit-count threshold. The only exempt properties are residences in a hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility, and residences in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is short-term treatment, assistance or therapy for alcohol, drug or other substance abuse.
coverage.other_conditions: Exempt: residences in any hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility; residences in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is providing short-term treatment, assistance or therapy for alcohol, drug or other substance abuse.

result.notes: Removed landlord conduct ('intending to end a tenancy') from the summary, because the coverage fields describe properties and owners only. landlord_size_condition is reworded to say that no size threshold exists. The exemptions turn on facility type, which is an observable property characteristic, so requires_unknown_facts stays false. The documents state no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or preemption terms for this ordinance, so those fields remain null. The ordinance text itself is not among the documents, and coverage rests on the official FAQ (D014) and the city page (D013).
